summary: Engineering scalable web and mobile applications integrating conversational AI, MCP server architectures, and high-performance FastAPI backends.
responsibilities: Applicant Management System: Built a full-featured automated recruitment system with role-based access control, candidate tracking, interview scheduling, and real-time status updates using ReactJS, FastAPI, and MySQL.

ezstaf Job Platform (Google Play Store): Spearheaded the end-to-end architecture, development, and production deployment of a cross-platform mobile recruitment app to the Google Play Store using Flutter, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.
AI Chatbot & Speech Processing: Integrated conversational chatbot workflows using Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server, Speech-to-Text (STT) audio pipelines, and ffmpeg processing.
Security & Performance: Implemented secure JWT authentication, profile management, and resilient RESTful microservice APIs optimized for high speed and reliability.
